name: orchestrator-agents
description: 7-agent catalog for the orchestrator ecosystem: reader (haiku), researcher (sonnet), thinker (sonnet), writer (sonnet), checker (haiku), reviewer (sonnet), tester (sonnet, readonly run+diagnose). All 7 return through a schema-validated tool call — write_findings or write_report. Leaf subagents — no nested Agent dispatch; readonly agents confined to their memory dir.
